size: 48x8 (4 frames of 12x8, one row, played once in order), RGBA 8-bit
method: Both 32x32 drawings (a crown splash, an isometric ripple ring) were read for shape and colour; the frames are placed pixel by pixel in 12x8 (nothing scaled). Colours: 8, all sampled from the two drawings (near white and one cyan hint from the crown, six pale-to-dark blue-greys from the ring; the crown's saturated royal blues were left out).
frames: 1 impact: white dot with cyan hint, tiny 4x3 ring (dark far edge, pale near side). 2 crown: 8x3 ring, rim walls rising at its sides, 3 droplets thrown up and out. 3 widest: 10x4 flat ellipse ring (darkest far edge, mid sides, bright near side), 2 droplets falling. 4 fading: 8 dark pixels of the broken ring.
preview: art-archive/T-509/screenshots/v1-2_preview_x12.png (nearest-neighbour x12 on a dark street and a pale roof colour; review only)
